text:
maria: FYI - upstream Ubuntu 22.04 OpenSSL/glibc patches landed. We still have api-runtime, model-worker, sidecar-proxy on older bases. Need plan: rebuild, sign, promote. Who can own canary + KMS signing flow?

kevin: I can own the canary pipeline. Plan: rebuild minimal images for amd64+arm64, run unit/e2e, deploy to canary k8s pool (low-traffic nodes) for 24h, then promote if metrics OK.

alyssa: Signing: use cosign + KMS. RBAC needed so CI (release-bot) can sign. Proposal:
- grant iam.signer to release-bot on signing key
- signing occurs in ephemeral job: cosign sign --key kms://gcp/projects/... or aws-kms://arn:...

tom: +1. Add manual approval step before prod promotion in GH Actions and require a human approver. Also enforce MFA on creator of release-bot credentials. Record PR id in attestation.

jordan: Watch ARM ABI differences. Last time model-worker segfaulted due to libcrypto symbol mismatch with static helpers. Run smoke infer on representative models on arm64 canary.

sre-lead: Observability: enable extended logs/traces on canary nodes, retain debug bucket 48h. Add alert: if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 1m during canary, auto-fail and rollback.

maria: CI checklist draft:
```
- build: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t registry/redwood/api-runtime@sha256:<digest>
- test: unit -> e2e -> infer-smoke (small <100MB model)
- sign: cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/release
- push: tag -> staging -> canary
- promote: manual approval -> prod tag (immutable digest promotion)
```

kevin: Use digest-based promotion (registry/...@sha256:...), not timestamp tags. Reproducible artifact is key.

alyssa: K8s RBAC: create short-lived signing service account via workload-identity (GCP) or assumed role (AWS). Limit scope to sign-only. Enable KMS audit log export to security project bucket.

security-bot: CVE-2026-XXXX severity=HIGH. Advisory: https://redwood-internal/adv/2026-XXXX

tom: Also evaluate alpine:3.18 vs ubuntu:22.04. Alpine's glibc-compat updated API; some binaries depending on glibc need ubuntu. Proposal: tiny sidecars -> alpine-slim, model-worker/runtime -> ubuntu for now.

jordan: +1. We'll create an arm64 regression matrix and include realtime smoke with small convo and model warmup.

maria: Regression/rollback plan: if canary fails, re-tag previous digest to canary, mark release as blocked, collect core dumps, upload to forensic bucket, open incident ticket.

sre-lead: Add audit metadata: approver GitHub username + timestamp and cosign attestation blob stored with image metadata. Hook alerting to #eng-sre.

alyssa: Ops verification commands:
```
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/... registry/redwood/api-runtime@sha256:abcdef
cosign attest --predicate predicate.json --key kms://...
```

kevin: I'll land pipeline + GH action that posts start/end status to #eng-sre. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maria: Action items:
- kevin: canary pipeline + smoke tests
- alyssa: RBAC doc + KMS audit export steps
- jordan: arm64 regression matrix
- sre-lead: alerting & rollback playbook

Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree or :eyes: if reviewing. We'll schedule a production window after thumbs.
